title: The Paystride Visa Payroll Card as a Destination for Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Transfers
content:
Holding a Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account changes where and at what fee a worker can receive early pay from the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.

**Rule.** When the tier requires an active card for card transfers, the Paystride card is offered as a destination only while the worker's card account status is active; a card that is issued but not yet activated, blocked or closed is not a destination, and the worker either chooses an external debit card or bank account at that destination's fee or waits until the card is active. The desk never books a card transfer to a card in another status in the expectation that it will be activated. A worker who holds no Paystride card can use only external destinations, and the card's status never limits a transfer to an external destination. A transfer to the card is credited to the card account as an early-wage load under the card charter.

| Card account status | Paystride card offered as a destination | External debit card or bank account |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | available |
| issued, not yet activated | no | available |
| blocked | no | available |
| closed | no | available |
| no Paystride card held | no | available |

*Basis question:* may a card transfer be booked now to a card the worker says they will activate later today? No — the card must be active when the transfer is booked.
